data.name: Awwab
data.gender_notes: Awwab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘awwaba’, which means ‘to return’ or ‘to come back’. This name is often used to describe someone who is persistent, determined, and committed to their goals. The name Awwab carries the meaning “Returning, Repeated” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awwab usually hope their child will grow to embody returning, repeated and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of perseverance and determination in the face of adversity
data.etymology: Awwab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Returning, Repeated.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awwab total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: عواب
in_arabic.meaning: عواب تعني كثير الرجوع إلى الله بالتوبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عواب مشتق من الفعل 'عاب' الذي يعني الرجوع إلى الله بالتوبة. في القرآن الكريم، يوصف الله بأنه 'عواب' أي كثير القبول للتوبة. هذا الاسم يوحي بالتوجه نحو الله وطلب المغفرة والعفو. عواب هو اسم ذو دلالة دينية وروحانية كبيرة في الإسلام.

in_pashto.name: عواب
in_pashto.meaning: عواب د ډیرو توبې کوونکی معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عواب نوم د عربی کلمو څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې د ډیرو توبې کوونکی دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره سم دی او په دیني لحاظ کې مهم ګڼل کیږي. عواب نوم د الهي طرف ته د رجوع او د ګناهونو د بخښنې غوښتنه څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Awwab
in_english.meaning: Awwab means one who frequently turns to Allah in repentance
in_english.long_meaning: The name Awwab is derived from the Arabic root 'ʿ-W-B' which signifies returning to Allah in repentance. In the Quran, Allah is described as 'Awwab', emphasizing His acceptance of repentance. The name Awwab holds significant spiritual and religious connotations in Islam, symbolizing a person's inclination towards seeking forgiveness and mercy from Allah. It is a name rich in cultural and historical context within Muslim communities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Awwab carries a significant cultural impact, especially among Arabic speaking communities. It is a strong and positive name that denotes resolve, determination, and persistence. The name may also be associated with the concept of 'returning to the faith' (Islam), as the root 'awwaba' can also mean 'reversion to Islam'. In modern times, this name is often given to children who their parents hope will grow up to be strong and steadfast individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, the name Awwab holds spiritual significance as well. It is a reminder of the importance of staying committed to one's faith and goals, even in the face of adversity. It also reflects the belief in the concept of repentance and returning to Allah (God) after making mistakes or straying from the right path. Ultimately, the name Awwab inspires a sense of perseverance and determination to always strive towards personal and spiritual growth.
